title: Duck Armor
description: This project adds armor to both ducks and geese from the Untitled Duck Mod!
body:
# Duck Armor

Equip your feathered friends for adventure!

**Duck Armor** is a lightweight addon for the **Untitled Duck Mod** that lets you equip ducks and geese with armor, giving them extra protection while keeping the mod simple and vanilla friendly.

Built with **Architectury**, Duck Armor supports both **Forge** and **Fabric** across **Minecraft 1.20–1.21.1**, making it easy to add to almost any modpack.

## Features

- Equip armor onto ducks.
- Equip armor onto geese.
- Compatible with Minecraft **1.20.x–1.21.1**.

## Requirements

- Untitled Duck Mod
- Architectury API (for your mod loader)
- Geckolib

## Compatibility

| Minecraft Version | Support |
|-------------------|---------|
| 1.20.x            | ✅ |
| 1.21.x            | ✅ (up to 1.21.1) |

Protect your flock and let your ducks march into battle in style!
